;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Israel]] kills two members of [[Islamic Jihad Movement in Palestine|Islamic Jihad]] in an aerial attack near [[Damascus]], [[Syria]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/02/israel-claims-air-strikes-syrian-capital-damascus-200223232221593.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Arts and culture
*The [[Carnival of Aalst]] in [[Belgium]] goes ahead despite [[UNESCO]] withdrawing its recognition of the event as a [[Masterpieces of the Oral and Intangible Heritage of Humanity|Masterpiece of the Oral and Intangible Heritage of Humanity]] because of [[Stereotypes of Jews|Jewish caricatures]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-belgium-carnival-aalst/belgian-carnival-defies-calls-to-cancel-parade-with-jewish-caricatures-idUSKCN20H0ND (Reuters)] [https://newsmonkey.be/aalst-carnaval-gaat-door-ondanks-stormweer-internationale-media-kijken-met-argusogen-wegens-antisemitische-praalwagen-van-vorig-jaar/ (newsmonkey)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2020 Iran–Turkey earthquakes]]
**An [[earthquake]] in [[West Azerbaijan Province]], [[Iran]], kills at least nine people and injures more than a hundred others. [https://www.dailysabah.com/turkey/2020/02/23/8-dead-after-magnitude-57-quake-jolts-turkey-iran-border (''Daily Sabah'')]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
***Seventy-six more coronavirus cases are confirmed in [[Italy]], bringing the number of the cases in the country to 155. [https://www.repubblica.it/cronaca/2020/02/23/news/coronavirus_italia-249329434/ (''La Repubblica'')]
***A 68-year-old woman dies of coronavirus in [[Crema, Lombardy|Crema]], Italy, bringing the number of deaths in the country to three. [https://www.tgcom24.mediaset.it/cronaca/lombardia/coronavirus-aumentano-i-contagi-il-norditalia-si-blinda-divieto-di-ingresso-e-allontanamento_15195468-202002a.shtml (Tgcom24)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
***[[South Korea]] confirms that 169 more people have contracted the coronavirus in the country, raising the total number to 602. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-51603251 (BBC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
***[[Pakistan]] closes [[Iran-Pakistan border|its border]] from [[Taftan]] with Iran due to increasing cases of coronavirus in Iran. [https://www.geo.tv/latest/273901-pakistan-seals-taftan (Geo News)]
***[[Turkey]] closes its border with Iran and halted incoming flights due to more cases of coronavirus in Iran. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-health-turkey/turkey-shuts-iran-border-halts-flights-due-to-coronavirus-idUSKCN20H0GH (Reuters)]
***[[Afghanistan]] suspends travel between it and Iran and reported three suspected virus cases in [[Herat]]. [https://www.trtworld.com/middle-east/turkey-pakistan-shut-iran-border-afghanistan-bans-travel-over-virus-fears-34039 (TRT World)]
